item.tib: rnam par dag pa'i 'dul ba'i spyod tshul dbyar gnas bslab bya'i rim pa
item.coloph: de ltar rnam dag 'dul ba'i spyod tshul gyis (gyi)/ dbyar gnas bslab bya'i rim pa mdo bsdus 'di/ stag rtse ri khrod mchog spral rnamaganyis kyis/ g.yung drung gling gi dgon gnas gsar bskran skabs/ 'di ltar dgos zhes bka'i (bkas) rab bskul ngor/ sgo rigs mkhan ming nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ gshen bstan sman ri'i bla brang dbu rtser sbyar/ dge ba'i 'dul bstan rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
